current_affairs_audit.fact: The official Finance Commission site states that the Sixteenth Finance Commission report was tabled in Parliament; GST Council and Inter-State Council Secretariat sites remain active on 24 August 2026.
current_affairs_audit.caveat: The 2019 river-water amendment Bill is not treated as enacted law; GST Council recommendations are not treated as binding commands.
